briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race with agentic breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as multiple labs release agentic models with improved multi-step reasoning. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows in the US and EU. Prompt injection attacks continue to rise in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native tool use and 128k context. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. DeepSeek R2 matches o3 performance at lower cost. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level with patent-pending multi-agent security for automotive and IoT.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell B200 clusters to xAI and Microsoft. Google announces TPU v6 pods with 40% efficiency gains. New 50MW data center announced in Texas for Anthropic.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed frontier labs by end of 2027?
